query:
UPDATE molecules SET 
  radar_intensity = 60,
  radar_freshness = 90,
  radar_warmth = 20,
  radar_sweetness = 25,
  radar_spiciness = 15,
  radar_earthiness = 35
WHERE (olfactiveProfile LIKE '%marin%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%marine%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%aqua%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%océan%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%sel%' OR olfactiveProfile LIKE '%sea%')
  AND radar_intensity = 50 AND radar_freshness = 50
